method: Items are published only when an official primary source or at least two independent publishers support them.

items.headline: UN chief in Islamabad backs voluntary Afghan returns as Pakistan raises cross-border militancy
items.summary: UN Secretary-General António Guterres said on 6 October in Islamabad that the UN will work with Pakistan so that returns of Afghans proceed in a voluntary, safe and dignified way. The same day Pakistan's President Asif Ali Zardari told him that Afghanistan-based militant groups continue to target Pakistan, according to Afghanistan International.
items.note: The Pakistani allegation is the government's position; the sources do not report a response from the Taliban authorities. Return figures in the Kabul Now article are background and come from Pakistani officials and UN agencies.
